title: PackageSharedDataStore
description: Edition-scoped shared runtime data declaration and current learner value.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.description: Registration required for attempt-lifetime state, absent for a verified cross-attempt learner scope.
registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

sharing_scope_key.description: Explicit learner and package scope chosen by approved policy.

store_value.description: Confidential shared text under edition value limits.

read_occurrence_ids.description: Manifest occurrences allowed to read this store.
read_occurrence_ids.x-reference-scope: Only activities in the approved sharing context.

write_occurrence_ids.description: Manifest occurrences allowed to write this store.
write_occurrence_ids.x-reference-scope: Only activities in the approved sharing context.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

learner_person_id.description: Exact authorized learner whose state may be shared.
learner_person_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

organization_id.description: Manifest organization when sharing is limited to its tree.
organization_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

persistence_scope.description: Resolved persistence scope from edition manifest and explicit tenant trust profile.

x-invariants: Enable only when the edition declares this extension.
Store grants are declared and separately checked on every read or write.

The scope key includes the registration for attempt lifetime and excludes it for retained tree or approved system lifetime. Shared writes compare the store revision under lock, including concurrent distinct registrations.
